description: This file defines the ContentPickerFieldDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and editing of ContentPickerField in OrchardCore CMS. It includes methods for rendering display shapes, editing forms, and updating field data, utilizing services like content management, localization, authorization, and Liquid templating.

classes.name: ContentPickerFieldDisplayDriver
classes.description: A driver class for rendering and editing ContentPickerField in OrchardCore, handling display, edit, and update operations.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Renders the display shape for ContentPickerField in detail and summary views.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the editing shape for ContentPickerField, populating selected items with content details.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to the ContentPickerField from form submissions, validating and setting content item IDs.
